note: Card data vendored from PlayfulProcess/recursive-tarot (tarot/tarot-de-marseille-conver). Trump scans are Conver 1760; the pips and courts are public-domain Marseille-pattern scans from Wikimedia. This deck was made to play tarot, a trick-taking card game — the divinatory meanings are a later overlay.

cards.name: The Fool
cards.icon: A traveller in motley walks rightward with a staff and bundle, a small animal tearing at his trailing leg

cards.name: The Magician
cards.icon: A young mountebank stands at a table of cups, coins, and knives, a wand in one hand, his hat brim a lemniscate

cards.name: The High Priestess
cards.icon: A seated, veiled woman in papal tiara holds an open book, a curtain behind her

cards.name: The Empress
cards.icon: A crowned woman enthroned with sceptre and an eagle shield

cards.name: The Emperor
cards.icon: A bearded sovereign sits in profile, legs crossed in the figure of four, sceptre and eagle shield at hand

cards.name: The Hierophant
cards.icon: A tiara'd pope raises his hand in blessing over two tonsured clerics, a pillar at each side

cards.name: The Lovers
cards.icon: A youth stands between two women under a blindfolded Cupid drawing his bow — the choice between two ways

cards.name: The Chariot
cards.icon: A crowned prince stands in a canopied chariot drawn by two horses facing different ways; he holds no reins

cards.name: Justice
cards.icon: An enthroned woman holds an upright sword and a level balance, eyes open

cards.name: The Hermit
cards.icon: A cloaked old man walks with a staff, lifting a lantern half-shielded by his cloak

cards.name: Wheel of Fortune
cards.icon: animal-eared creatures rise on one side and fall on the other, a sphinx-like figure crowning the top

cards.name: Strength
cards.icon: A woman in a wide hat calmly parts the jaws of a lion

cards.name: The Hanged Man
cards.icon: A youth hangs by one ankle from a wooden frame between two trees, hands behind his back, leg crossed; his face is calm

cards.name: Death
cards.icon: A skeleton with a scythe mows a black ground from which hands, feet, and crowned heads sprout

cards.name: Temperance
cards.icon: A winged angel pours liquid between two vessels in an unbroken stream

cards.name: The Devil
cards.icon: A horned, bat-winged figure on a pedestal raises a torch; two small horned captives are chained below

cards.name: The Tower
cards.icon: Lightning knocks the crown from a tower; two figures fall headlong amid coloured spheres

cards.name: The Star
cards.icon: A naked woman kneels by water pouring two urns onto land and stream, a great star and seven smaller ones above

cards.name: The Moon
cards.icon: Under a dripping face-moon two dogs bay between two towers while a crayfish climbs from a pool

cards.name: The Sun
cards.icon: Two children stand by a low wall beneath a great rayed face-sun that drips golden tears

cards.name: Judgement
cards.icon: An angel sounds a trumpet from the clouds; three figures rise from a tomb with arms raised

cards.name: The World
cards.icon: A dancing figure within a pointed-oval wreath, the four living creatures — angel, eagle, lion, bull — in the corners
